text: *Draft 1:* I have a friend who spent years perfecting a triple-redundant backup system. He was so worried about the folder structures and syncing hard drives that he forgot to actually start looking at the photos. Last week, he searched for a photo of his daughter's first birthday and realized he hadn't opened that specific folder in a decade. The lesson? Total safety without curation is just a digital graveyard. If you spend all your time protecting the data, you lose the memory. (88 words)
